tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rab gnas bkra shis snye ma'i dgongs rgyan don gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs/

bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir rab gnas bkra shis snye ma'i dgongs pa bzhin lag len khyer bder brjod par bya ba la/ thog mar/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum/ gang la brten pa de'i bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa bya/ zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar yin yang*/ 'dir gtso bor 'jigs byed kyi dbang du byas na/ 'di la gsum/ sngon 'gro'i rim pa/ dngos gzhi'i rim pa/ mjug mnga' dbul sogs kyi rim pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ thog mar bya ba'i rim pa/ sbyang ba'i rim pa khrus kyi rim pa'o/ /dang po la sdom pa ni/ bdag bskyed bum pa lhag gnas bya/ /khrus stegs rgyan bri mnga' dbul bri/ /gsol gdab sems bskyed rten bskyed de/ /gdan la rten bzhag chu bzhi dbul/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thog mar 'jigs byed kyis bdag bskyed dang bum pa lha gnas kyang byas la/ khrus stegs sgo nub tu bstan pa'i re kha gru pa'i dbus su/ padma 'dab brgyad tshon gyis bris pa'am/ mnga' dbul chang bar yod na des kyang chog /med na gsar du bri zhing khrus stegs kyi mthar rgyan gyis mdzes par bya'o/ /ye dharmā'i sgo nas me tog sgrub tshul 'og tu 'byung yang*/ bum chu 'dis gsol gdab kyi skabs kyi me tog la'ang bran dgos pas lag len gyi tshe bum pa lhag gnas kyi rjes su byed do zhes gsungs pas/ de'i rim pa ni/ me long la tsanda dkar bo dang gur gum ghi hang sogs sbyar ba'i mtshal lam snag tshas ye dha rmā ngag tu brjod bzhin par dbus su oṃ ma ma hūṃ dang*/ mthar ye dharmā'i ye ge rnams mgo phyir bstan te bris pa me tog gi steng du bzhag la / ye dharmā'i sngags phreng gyen du 'greng zhing 'od zer dang bcas par gyur ba'i 'od zer gyis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bcud thams cad dang*/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan thams cad bsdus nas sngags phreng me tog dang bcas pa la thim par gyur

bar bsams la/ ye dharmā brgya rtsa sogs ci 'grub bzlas la me tog bsgrubs/ de nas ye dha rmā bris pa dbus chus bkrus nas me tog la bran cing bum chus kyang bkru/ 'dir rdzas rnams snod so sor bshams tshul 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bya zhing*/ khrus bum rgyas pa 'dod na gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar dang mchod pa byin rlabs kyang bya'o/ /de nas skabs 'dir chas 'jug byed ba'am ma byas kyang mi 'gal la/ gsol ba gdab cing sems bskyed pa ni lag tu me tog thogs te/ stod pa sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dran ba'i sgo nas/ gang 'dir bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das te/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dgongs pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ chos thams cad thugs su chud pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di dag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /gang 'dir bcom ldan 'das kyi byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang yang dag par ldan pa/ stobs bcu dang*/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang*/ ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum dang thugs rje chen po la sogs pa mdor na slob pa dang mi slob pa'i sangs rgyas su byed pa'i chos rnams dang ldan pa/ de'i nyes pa'i skyon thams cad dang bral zhing*/ bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan gyi chos tshad med pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /gang 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi bla na med pa'i tshul khṛms la sogs pa'i phung bo lnga dang yang dag par ldan pa/ cho 'phrul gsum dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gsum dang*/ bslab pa gsum dang*/ tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi dang*/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang yang dag par ldan pa/ de'i yang dag pa phyin ci ma logs pa'i ye shes dang*/

shes bya'i yul thams cad brnyes pas nyon mongs pa la sogs pa rnams ma lus par spangs pa dang*/ bdud bzhi las rab tu rgyal ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /gang 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yang dag par bsags pa dang*/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis yang dag par brgyan pa dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad bcus rnam par mdzes pa dang*/ skyes bu chen po'i sku lta bas chog mi shes pa dang*/ mthong na mi 'thun pa med pa ste/ de'i gzugs kyi sku'i 'byor ba mthar thug pa/ 'gro ba ma lus pa'i rtsa lag tu gyur pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ / zhes brjod cing*/ mthar rab tu gnas bya'i rten la/ me tog 'thor/ spos gyis bdug / rol mo dbul zhing*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ shakya mu ne ye/ ta thā ga ta ya ar ha te/ saṃ mya ga saṃ bud dhā ya/ ta dya thā/ oṃ mu ne mu ne ma hā mu ne ye swā hā dang*/ oṃ ya mānta ka hūṃ phaṭa sogs rab tu gnas bya'i lha gang yin gyi snying bo nye snying sogs kyi sngags dang*/ oṃ badzra satwa hūṃ dang oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod do/ /cung zad sbro na rab tu gnas par bgyi'o zhes pa'i tshig mtshams rnams su sngags brjod cing me tog 'dor zhing*/ lan gsum mam gcig gis kyang chogade nas sems bskyed pa ni/ sems can thams cad la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bskyed la/ 'di skad ces/ /ngo mtshar chen po grangs med cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /de dag thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du dkon mchog gsum gyi rten rab tu gnas par bgyi bas/ de'i mthus bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi dbugs dbyung ngo*/

/'khor ba'i gcong rong chen po las bsgral bar bgyi'o/ /phas kyi rgol ba bdud dang log 'dren thams cad pham par bgyi'o/ /sems can rnams kyi bag chags kyi 'tshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa'i rtog pa thams cad bsal bar bgyi'o/ / sems can rnams kyi nga rgyal gyi ri bo bsnyil bar bgyi'o/ /sems can rnams kyi skye ba'i ljon shing rtsad nas bcad do/ /'chi bdag gi nyi ma phye mar brlag go /ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal bar bgyi'o/ /ma dad pa dang*/ phyi rol ba dag dang*/ lta ba phyin ci log pa dag yang dag pa'i lta ba la gzud cing dad par bsgyur ro/ / las kyi chu bo bzlog par bgyi'o/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho bskam par bgyi'o/ /chos kyi sgraun me sbar bar bgyi'o/ /byang chub kyi lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /bzod pa dang des sa la gzud do/ /bsam gtan gyi bde ba la cher bstsal to/ /'dod chags kyi me dpung zhi bar bgyi'o/ /zhe sdang gi mtshon rnon po gzhom par bgyi'o/ /bden pa la gzud do/ /phrag dog gi 'tshub ma zhi bar bgyi'o/ /ser sna'i mdud pa dgrol bar bgyi'o/ /sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar bgyi'o/ / 'jig pa ma mchis pa dang bde ba chen po'i grong khyer du 'jug cing gnas par bgyi'o/ /de bas na bdag la las kyi dngos grub kyi mchog stsol zhing gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes brjod cing me tog gtor ro/ /de nas rten bskyed pa ni/ oṃ khaḍga dhrika hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes brjod cing las bum gyi chu rten la gtor te bsangs shū n+ya tas stong par sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las sku gzugs rnams sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la hūṃ las gis mtshan pa de yongs su gyur pa las dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po sku mdog mthing nag zhes pa nas klong dkyil na bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje ro langs ma nas yab la 'khyud pa/ gsang 'dus kyi sgo nas yin na zhe sdang rdo rje 'am rdo rje 'chang yum bcas su bskyed kyang rung*/

gsung rab kyi po ti dang gzungs rnams pad nyi'i steng du hrīḥlas padma hrīḥs mtshan pa las 'od dpag med dmar bo padma dang dril bu 'dzin pa rang 'dra'i yum gos dkar mos 'khyud pa/ yang na 'dod chags gshin rje gshed du bskyed/ mchod rten dang gtsug lag khang sogs pad zla'i steng du bhruṃ las 'khor lo bhruṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam snang dkar bo 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa rang 'dra'i yum spyan ma la 'khyud pa/ yang na gti mug gshin rje gshed du bskyed/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las lha de dag gzugs brnyan du shar ba'i gsung rab kyi yig 'bru dang*/ mchod rten dang gtsug lag khang dang khang bzang dang sku gzugs so sor gyur/ pa'am gang rung yin pa de brjod/ lang na thun mong du/ rten rnams sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa zhes pa nas/ yab la 'khyud pa'i bar dang*/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las zhes pa man gzhung du yod pas brjod na legs shing*/ gzugs bsgyur du dogs na bzhag chog/rten na bza' ser pos g.yog cing me tog dang ldan par bya'o/ / oṃ tiṣṭha badzre hoḥ.oṃ spha ra ṇa badzra hoḥ zhes brjod/ gdan la rten bzhag chu bzhi dbul pa ni/ rten rnams khrus dkyil gyi steng du dngos su bzhag pa'am/ bzhugs par mos la/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten rnams khrus dkyil gyi steng du 'khod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pū dze me gha sa mu tra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ de bzhin du sngags kyi thog mtha' 'dra ba la/ arghaṃ gyi gnas su pā dyaṃ/ añtsa ma ṇaṃ/ prokṣa ṇaṃ sbyar te chu bzhi dbul/ de nas sbyang ba'i rim pa ni/ sdom ni/ gtor ma yungs chu khams por lci/ /zan changs ras kyis bya bas nas ni/ /nye reg mchod bdug sbyang ba'o/ /zhes pa ltar las/ thog mar khro bo spyan drang pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ khro bo'i tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/

hūṃ ye shes bskal ba'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ / zhes pa nas/ 'gro ba'i don du mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ khro bo'i tshogs thams cad spyan drangs te/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ badzre mahā kro dha rā dza sa pā ri wa ra arghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu tra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ de bzhin du sbyar nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ nang mchod kyang 'bul/ hūṃ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med dang nyid las/ zhes pa nas/ bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gtor ma rnams oṃ khaḍga dhrika hūṃ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa stong bar sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ /rab tu gnas pa la bar du gtso'i bgegs rnams bkug par gyur/ oṃ sarba bighnan na ma sarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba tad khaṃ ud ga te sphar ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhna daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis g.yas su bskor zhing bsngos la zhi bas sbyang*/ ting lo chang bu mthe' kyu dang bcas pa phyir bskor zhing*/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūṃ/ gṛhna gṛhna hūṃ/ gṛhnā pa ya gṛhnā pa ya hūṃ/ a na ya ho bha ga wan bidhā rā dza hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes lan gsum ste zhi drag phyed mas sbyang*/ hūṃ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i/ zhes pa nas/ bgegs rnams brlag par 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ na mo sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bden pa dang dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang*/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ padma dang*/ las kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad dang*/ snying bo dang phyag rgya dang gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi lha'i khyad par thams cad kyis bden pa dang*/ dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rab tu gnas par byed pa la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa de dag thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim par gyis la zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas rang rang so so'i gnas su song shig

/gal te mi 'gro na khro bo'i ye shes kyi rdo rje me rab tu 'bar bas mgo bo rnam pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /hrīḥṣtī dang*/ sumbha ni drag tu brjod de gtor ma rnams rten la phyir bskor nas phyi rol du 'dog /gu gul gyi bdugs/ yungs kar gyis brab/ rol mo'i tsham rngam sogs kyis sbyang ba ni drag po'i sbyang ba'o/ /de nas yungs kar dang chu dang*/ kham lor dkar po dang*/ dur ba'i myu gu dang bcas pa'i ba gci'i chang bu dang*/ zan chang dang*/ seng ras rnams la hūṃ lan bdun bzlas la/ thog mar yungs kar lag pa g.yas g.yon gyi khu tshur kyis bzung nas lan gnyis g.yon du bskor cing*/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ya badzra satwa sya sarba pā paṃ da ha swā hā/ zhes brjod cing me nang dang*/ de bzhin du g.yas su skor nas kyang dor ro/ de bzhin du chu nas seng ras kyi bar rnams g.yon dang g.yas su skor nas bya bas te dor ro/ /'on kyang kham phor man chad mer mi dor zhing kham phor nas seng ras kyi bar drug po rnams re re yang bzhi bzhi tshang bar bya'o/ /de nas lag pa g.yon par chu gtsang bzung*/ g.yas pa'i gung mo dang srin lag gi chu blangs te rten dngos sam me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba'i kha rna ba mig sna kha lag lte ba mgo rnams su nye reg bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i sngags brjod cing zhes gsung la te/ de yang*/ oṃ hrīḥṣtīḥwi kri tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ rten rnams kyi thugs kar dri/ de bzhin du re re la sbyar te dbu la me tog/mdun du mchod yon/ mar me skor bzhin pa dang*/ oṃ badzra a mri ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa dang*/ hūṃ lan bdun bzlas pa'i mar dang bcas pa'i spos dkar gyis bdug par bya'o/ /de rnams ni sbyang ba'i rim pa'o/ /gsum pa khrus kyi rim pa la sdom ni/ snyan gsan bdud 1rtsi ba byung 2chu3/ /shing shun 4'bru mar 5kyu ru ra6/

/yung 7ba dri lnga'i phye me rnams/ /dur sngon pir gyis byugs nas su/ /lha rnams sbyan drangs bkra shis glu/ /sngon byas lha yi bum pa'i chus/ /bkru dbyi dri dang gos rgyan khrus/ /zhes pa ltar las/ thog mar snyan gsan ni/ khrus bum lag tu thogs/ thams cad 'greng ste bya ba'am 'dug kyang rung ste mgrin gcig tu/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad la yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa'i khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi'o/ /ri bo ltar ni mdzes pa yi/ /yon tan dam pa'i rgyan ldan pa/ /mchod gnas rin chen 'di dag la/ /bdag gis khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi/ /ma rig 'joms pa'i nyi ma ste/ /srid pa'i nad ni sel ba'i sman/ /dam chos rin chen 'di dag la/ /bdag gis khrus = /chos kyi sku yi bdag nyid can/ /mchog gi yon tan gzugs can gyi/ /mchod rten rin chen 'di dag la/ /bdag gis= /bskal ba'i mtha' yi dngos 'joms pa/ /'jigs byed mi yi cha byad can/ /mgon po snying rje'i stobs ldan pa/ /bdag gis= /mchog tu tshim zhing skal ba bzang*/ /dam pa'i 'dud rtsis mdzes cha byed*/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i sku 'di la/ /bdag gis= /gdul bya'i sems can gang dag la/ /rgyal ba'i sprul sku mang po yi/ /cha byad lha yi rnam pa zhi/ /snying rje yis ni des gang ba/ /rtag tu phan dang bde mdzad pa'i/ /mchog tu dul ba de dag la/ /bdag gis= /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan gnas dang ni/ /slob pa'i dge 'dun gnas kyi sa/ /gtsug lag khang dang gnas gzhan la/ /bdag gis khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi/ /

zhes dbyangs dang bcas pas ci ltar rigs par brjod/ de na zho 'o ma mar sbrang rtsi ka ra te bdud rtsi lnga/ ba ser mo'i 'o ma zho mar dag gci ba chu ste ba byung lnga/ dri bzang bo'i chu/ /n+ya groṇta u dum wa ra la shi bi pa la gha na dha mu dra ste 'o ma can gyis shing lnga zhes bshad kyang ma rnyed na 'om bu sogs 'o ma can shing ji ltar rigs pa'i phye ma dang*/ dri zhim po'i 'bru mar dang*/ skyu ru ra'i phye ma dang*/ yung ba'i phye ma dang*/ tsanda dkar dmar gur gu ma a ka ru sran thig ste lnga'am/ gur gum a ka ru gla rtsi ga bur tsandan ste lnga'i phye ma rnams 'khar ba'i snod du sbyar ba la/ oṃ hrīḥṣtīḥwi kri tā na na hūṃ phaṭa dang*/ hūṃ lan bdun bzlas la/ dud pa'i chun po'i pir gyis blangs te/ thog mar bdud rtsi dang ba byung gnyis la/ tshigs bcad mi 'dra ba yod kyang 'don bde ched/ rgyal ba rnams ni gtsang gyur cing*/ /sme ba'i rtog pa mi mnga' yang*/ /srid zhu'i tshul kyis dag byed 'dis/ /bde gshegs rnams la byug par bgyi/ /oṃ hūṃ traṃ hrīḥ.āḥ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha na ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing sku gzugs dngos sam/ me long du gzugs brnyan shar pa la re re 'am gsum gsum byug cing bsdu na kun la tshigs bcad 'di tsam bya/ dri bzang gi chu la/ rgyal ba rnams ni nas/ tshul gyis dri chab 'dis/ /bde gshegs rnams la khrus bgyi'o/ /oṃ hūṃ sogs dang*/ rdzas gzhan la/ rgyal ba rnams ni nas/ tshul gyis phye ma 'dis/ bde gshegs sku ni dril zhing dbyi/ /oṃ hūṃ sogs sngar ltar bya'o/ /'on kyang 'bru mar la sgos su byed na/ rgyal ba rnams ni nas/ tshul du 'bru mar 'dis/ /bde gshegs byug pa'i rim gro bgyi/ /oṃ hūṃ sogs te/ 'di mjug tu byas na legs so/ /de nas lha rnams spyan drang pa ni/ rangagi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros gshegs pa dang gshegs ma sems dpa' dang sems ma khro bo dag khro mo'i tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/

de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ spyan ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa dkar bos dbang bskur/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pas shis pa brjod/ khro bo rnams phyogs 'tshams su 'khod nas bgegs bskrad par gyur/ / bkra shis kyi glu ni/ / bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /kun gyi bdag nyid dam pa'i rigs rnams kyi ni rje/ /ma lus sems can bskyed byed bde ba chen po ste/ /bkra shis des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur/ /bkra shis gang zhig ma lus rdo rje'i rigs dang ldan/ /sdang bas zil gnon skye bo yongs su sbyong byed cing*/ /mi bskyod mgon po zhes byar mtshan gsol de yis ni/ /bkra shis des= /bkra shis gang zhig mtha' dag 'khor lo'i rigs dang ldan/ /rnam par snang mdzad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rtag 'phrog cing*/ /rmongs pas zil gnon skye bo yongs su spyod mdzad pa/ /bkra shis= /bkra shis gang zhig ma lus ri ni rigs dang ldan/ /phongs pa'i sdug bsngal yongs su grol bar rab brtson zhing*/ /khengs pas zil gnon 'gro ba yongs su spyod mdzad pa/ /bkra shis= /bkra shis gang zhig ma lus padma'i rigs dang ldan/ /'jig rten dbang phyug srid pa'i dra ba 'joms pa bo/ /chags pas zil gnon skye bo yongs su sbyong mdzad pa/ /bkra shis= /bkra shis gang zhig ma lus las kyi rigs dang ldan/ brtse ba'i bdag nyid log par lta ba nges par spong*/ /de sbyong thabs ston de ni kun nas sel mdzad pa/ /bkra shis des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur/ /zhes sngon du btang*/ de nas dbus su oṃ dang phyogs bzhir hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥbazhi bkod pa'i khrus ras dang bcas te khrus bya ba ni/ /ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣi ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadzra satwa hūṃ hūṃ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing*/ me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba la bkru/ sngags gnyis 'og ma rnams la'ang 'gre'o/ / rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad ci rigs dang*/ de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la/ / zhes sogs kyis khrus gsol zhing rol mo'i sgra yang bya'o/ /de nas khyod ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chus/ /ser sna'i dri ma spyod mdzad cing*/ gtong ba dri yis legs bgos pa/ khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal bdud/ khyod tshul khrims= khrims 'chal dri ma= /tshul khrims dri yis= khrus= khyod ni bzod pa'i= /zhes sdang dri ma= /byams pa dri= khrus= khyod ni brtson 'grus= /le lo'i dri= /brtson 'grus dri= khrus= khyod ni bsam gtan= /rnam g.yeng = /ting 'dzin dri= khrus= khyod ni shes rab= /shes 'chal= /ye shes= khrus= /chu bo drug gis khrus byas shing*/ /dri ma rnam drug spyod mdzad pa/ /rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa/ khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gang la nyes pa mi mnga' zhing*/ /yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas de la thar don du/ /dad pas bdag gis khrus gsol lo/ / zhes khrus bya/ de nas sku mchog rnam dag blta bas mi ngoms la/ /ngo mtshar skyon bral mkha' dkyil nyi gsal 'dra/ /chos kyi sku la dri ma mi mnga' yang*/ /srid zhu bkur sti rim gro'i tshul tsam du/ /chu gtsang sman spos 'o ma 'dag chal chus/ /'gro ba'i lus sems sdug bsngal nad bsal te/ nyes pa'i skyon bral 'gro ba'i yid 'ong ba'i/ /dam pa'i sku mchog bdag gis thob par shog/ zhes brjod/ sku dbyi ba ni/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku dbyi'o/ /oṃ hūṃ traṃ hrīḥ.oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi shodha na ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing*/ khrus ras kyis dbyi'o/

/ bde gshegs sku mchog mtshan dang dpe mnga' yang*/ /'gro ba'i don du gzugs sku cir yang gda'/ /rin chen dbyig ltar nyes pa'i skyon bral yang*/ /'jig rten srid zhu gus pa'i tshul tsam du/ /sdig med rgyal ba rnams kyis rab bsngags pa'i/ /ras mchog 'di yis rgyal ba'i sku phyis pas/ /nyon mongs dug gsum sgrib pa kun byang nas/ /sku gsum ngang du bdag cag 'gyur bar shog/ ces bya'o/ /de nas stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yi/ /dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku/ /gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar/ /'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug bar bgyi/ /oṃ badzra ghandhe swā hā/ zhes brjod cing*/ dri bzang bos byug go /de nas na bza' dang rgyan 'bul ba ni/ / sna tshogs dbang bo'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing*/ /gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur pa'i/ /gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul/ /bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /oṃ badzra wa st+ra ye āḥhūṃ swāhā/ zhes na bza' dang*/ bde gshegs sku mchog mtshan dang dpe byad dang*/ rin chen 'od chags 'bar bas sku brgyan zhing*/ /byang chub phyogs kyi rgyan gyis mdzes lags kyang*/ /'jig rten bkur sti rim gro'i tshul tsam du/ /rin chen phreng ba se mo do shal dang*/ /rgyan gyi dam pa khyad par mchog phul bas/ /byang chub phyogs kyi rgyan dang ldan gyur nas/ bla med theg pa mchog la spyod par shog /oṃ badzra a laṅka ra wa puṣa ṇe swā hā/ zhes rgyan dbul lo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la sdom ni/ /mig dang sku sogs byin gyis brlab/ /ye shes spyan drang sa mchod nas ni/ /gsol gdab dam tshig pa la gzhug/dbang lha spyan drangs mchod nas ni/ /dbang bskur rigs bdag gis rgyas bdab / /mchod bstod gos rgyan me long bstan/ /sbyin sreg dbul zhing spyan dbye sogs/ /zhabs bsil mchod yon so rtsi dbul/ /dam bsgrags nas ni gzugs bsgyur bya/

/zhes pa ltar las/ dang bo mig dang sku sogs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ lha rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ dkar bo/ /mgrin par āḥlas byung ba'i padma dmar bo 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su āḥdamar bo/ thugs kar hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga ba'i lte bar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ ces tsam 'am/ rgyas par byed na/ dkyil 'khor gang gi dbang du byas pa'i skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa sgrub thabs so so'i gzhung ltar bya'o/ /sngar rten rnying ba la ar chog byas pa yin na/ skabs 'dir dar bsal nas chu gnyis nyer spyod lngas mchod de/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis rten rnying ba'i dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa rnams rten gsar ba'i dam tshig pa so so'i steng du spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥrten so so dang gnyis su med par gyur ces brjod do/ /de nas ye shes pa spyan drang ba ni/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ /bdud sde dpung bcas mi zad 'joms mdzad lha/ / zhes pa nas nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ / zhes pa'i bar dang de nas lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros rab tu gnas bya'i rten rnams kyi ye shes pa dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ /bcom ldan thugs rjes byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*/ /thugs la dgongs bzhin gnang bar mdzod/ /oṃ badzra ga ga na sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ ji ltar bltams pa zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig sngags dang bcas pas khrus gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de sṛd bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/

/padma tsand+ra ā sa ni tiṣṭhantu/ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhed nas ni/ /bdag kyang blo dang ldan par mdzod/ ces gsol nas/ mchod pa ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu tra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūṃ/ zhes mchod yon dang*/ de bzhin du zhab bsil nas rol mo'i bar gyis mchod/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rang gi lce hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rjer gyur/ rdo rje spos dang bcas pa 'dzin cing dril bu dkrol zhing*/ thugs rje yi ni bdag can bdag /slob ma rnams la rjes brtse dang*/ khyed rnams la yang mchod slad du/ /da ltar rab gnas bgyid par 'tshal/ /bcom ldan gus pas bdag la ni/ /de phyir bka' drin mdzad par 'os/ /bdag ni mi bskyod rdo rje yis/ /sku gsung thugs rten rab gnas ni/ /yon bdag ci nus yo byad kyis/ /da lta yang dag bgyid par 'gyur/ /de phyir slob mar bcas bdag la/ /rjes su brtse bas nyer bzung nas/ /'khor bcas kun gyis rab gnas la/ /byin gyis rlob par mdzad par 'os/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ lha rnams kyis dgyes bzhin du gnang ba sbyin par gyur/ phyag rgya dang bcas te/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥye shes pa rnams dam tshig pa so so dang gnyis su med par gyur/ / de nas dbang bskur rgyas gdab ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas gshegs pa dang gshegs ma/ sems dpa' dang sems ma/ khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ zhes pa nas shapta pū dza ma gha sa mu tra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shī āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang skur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ spyan ma la sogs pa rig ma dang bcas pa nam mkhar bzhugs pa rnams kyis gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa rab tu gnas bya'i lha rnams kyi steng phyogs su 'dzin glu gar mdzad cing rol mo brdung*/

me tog dang gur gum la sogs pa'i char 'bebs/ phyag gis cung zad yo bar bzung ba'i bum pa dkar bo bdud rtsis gang ba rnams kyis dbang bskur/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa rnams kyis bkra shis kyi glu dbyangs kyi shis pa brjod/ khro bo rnams phyogs 'tshams su 'khod nas bgegs bskrad par gyur/ /ji ltar bltams ba tsam gyis ni/ / zhes sogs sdegs dang bcas pa brjod la/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur ba la/ lus thams cad gang dri ma thams cad dag / chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur ba las mi bskyod pa la sogs pa rigs bdag so sos dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas mchod pa na ི chu bzhi dang bcas pa'i mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa la/ rgyal ba rnams kyis sam/ dag cing dri med zhes sogs kyis chu bzhi dang*/ rgyal ba rnams ni yon tan mchod gi zhes sogs sam/ lha yi me tog zhes sogs nyer skyod lnga rol mo dang bcas pa so so'i sngags phyag rgya dang bcas pas dbul/ /de nas bstod pa ni rten gtso bo gcig pu yin na/ 'jam dpal gser mdog ma'am/ gnyis med thun mong ma yin khyab pa'i sku/ zhes sogs sho lo ka gnyis tsam gyis bstod cing*/ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dang gti mug gshin rje gshed du bskyed na de gnyis kyis bstod pa yang bya/ yang na phyag na ral gri phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces pa'i bar yang rung*/ gsang 'dus las/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ / zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gam lngas bstod/ de nas gos zung 'phyar la/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos/ / zhes pa nas/ oṃ badzra wa sta ye āḥhūṃ swāhā/ zhes na bza' dang*/ de nas rgyan yod na ba ta ེgas te/ rgyal ba mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin rgyan ldan zhing*/ rgyan gzhan dag gis brgyan par mi 'tshal yang*/ /rin chen rgyan mchog phul bas 'gro kun gyis/ /mtshan dpes rgyan pa'i sku lus thob par shog/oṃ badzra a laṅka ra wa bu ṣa ni āḥhūṃ swāhā/

me long bstan pa ni/ me long rten ngos su 'phyar te / a las skyes pa'i me long*/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dwangs la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag 'byung*/ /oṃ badzra satwa aḥ zhes bstan/ de nas grub rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg chogs rab tu gnas bya'i lha rnams thab tu sbyan drangs pa la bsreg blug brgya rtsa sogs dbul/ /spyan dbye ba ni/ dngul gyi gong bur bzhag pa'i mar dang sbrar rtsi sogs mig sman gser gyi thur mas blangs te rten gyi sbyan la byug pa'i tshul byas nas/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal bo yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis khyod kyi ni/ /mi shes pa yi rab rib bsal/ oṃ tsakṣu tsakṣu sa manta tsakṣu bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang*/ /gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas/ /nam mkha'i mthar gtugs gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob par shog /zhi ba la sogs pa'i las rnams sgrub pa'i don du sbyin bdag la sogs pa la ye shes kyi gzigs pa lhur mdzad par gyur/

de nas bsgrubs pa'i 'o thugs snod bzang bor lha bshos chen po zas sna tshogs dang rgyan gyis brgyan par bshams la/ nang mchod ltar bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs te/ bteg nas/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg ldan pa'i/ / mchog tu gyur ba'i zas mchog 'di/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul bar bgyi/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ di bya a ka ni sa ma dhidhya ni pra ṇa ye swā hā/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa'i yid 'phrog pa/ /legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas la/ /dad pas phul bas 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /rgyal bas bdud bcom byang chub sangs rgyas te/ /rgyal ba'i sku la sbrebs skyems mi mnga' yang*/ /bdag cag bsod nams zhing du 'gyur slad du/ /bshol dang zhal zas sbyar ba 'di phul bas/ /dus kun dge ba'i lo tog 'phel rgyas nas/ /bde ba can du padmo las skyes te/ /ting 'dzin zas dang chos la spyod par shog / de nas zhal bsil dang mchod yon sngar gyi sngags kyis dbul zhing*/ so rtsi yang bteg pa/ oṃ badzra taṃ pu la ye swā hā/ zhes pas dbul/ de nas gzugs bsgyur ni/ oṃ hūṃ hrāṃḥ.āḥ zhes brjod la dam tshig bsgrags la/ de nas rten gang du bskyed pa'i lha de'i sngags/ oṃ ya mānta ka hūṃ phaṭa/ lta bu dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum re brjod la rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pa g.yas pas reg pa'am reg par mos te/ rdo rje 'jig byed yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i bris 'bur gyi sku gzugs so so dang*/ rnam snang ngam gti mug gshin rje gshed yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten sogs dang*/ 'od dpag med dam 'dod chags gshin rje gshed yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i gsung rab dang yig 'bru so so'i rnam par gyur/ thams cad 'jigs byed du bskyed pa yin na/ rdo rje 'jigs byed yab yum zhu ba las rten so so'i rnam par gyur/

ces bya'o/ /gsum pa 'jug mnga' dbul sogs bya ba'i tshul la gsum/ mkhar dbul ji ltar bya ba'i tshul/ rab tu gnas pa'i gco bo shis pa brjod cing brtan bzhugs bya ba'i tshul/ yon bdag dang chos skyong bsgo ba'i tshul sogs so/ /dang po la spyi dang bye brag gi mnga' da bul gnyis las/ sdom ni / chu bzhi nyer spyod 'dod yon lnga/ /nang mchod dbul zhing bstod pa bya/ /dkyil 'khor rtags brgyad khrus gos rgyan/ /'dod yon rin chen bdun dang bcud/ /gdugs sogs 'bru dang rin chen sna/ /sman dang bkra shis spyi yi'o/ /zhes pa'i rim pa ltar las/ mchod bstod ni/ mchod pa byin gyis brlab la/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho sogs sam rab 'byams rgya mtsho lam/ rgyal ba rnams ni gtsang zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wa ra 'am/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru bungngha be nghi satwa sa pā ri wa ra arghaṃ zhes pa nas shapta'i bar dang*/ rin chen dbang gi rgyal bo zhes sogs sngags dang bcas pas 'dod yon sna lnga 'bul/ oṃ sarba zhes pa nas/ sa pā ri wa ra oṃ āḥhūṃ gis nang mchod kyang phul/ 'jam dpal gser mdog ma'am/ gnyis med thun mong ma yin khyab pa'i sku/ / zhes sogs dang*/ gzhan bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems sogs rang rang gi bstod pa ci rigs kyis bstod/ gsang 'dus la/ mi bskyod rdo rje'am/ gang zhig gzugs dang ngam/ rgyal ba'i lhan skyes sogs kyis bstod/ de nas dkyil 'khor ni/ gling bzhi ri rab sogs la mnga' dbul bris pa'am/ maṇḍal la tshom bu bgod pa la dmigs te/ maṇḍal rgyas pa'am/ sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ / zhes sogs kyis dbul/ bkra shis rtags brgyad dbul ba ni/ ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la/ /dpal gyi be'u g.yu drung 'khyil/ /dge ba'i don du mnga' ba ltar/ /bdag gis dpal be'u dbul bar bgyi/ /ji ltar= /gser gyi 'khor lo mu khyud can/ /tshangs pa chen po'i phul ba ltar/

/de bzhin bdag gis dbul bar bgyis/ /ji ltar= /'dam gyi skyon gyis ma gos pa'i/ /padma dkar bo phul ba ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis= /ji ltar= /nyon mongs bdud las rgyal ba yi/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan phul ba ltar/ /de bzhin= /ji ltar= /gdugs dkar gser gyi yu ba can/ /phul ba de bzhin bdag 'bul gyi/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /ji ltar= /re ba thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa'i/ /bum pa bzang bo phul ba ltar/ /de bzhin= /ji ltar= /snyan pa phyogs bcur sgrog pa yi/ /'bud dung g.yas 'khyil phul ba ltar/ /de bzhin= /ji ltar= /na bza' gser gyi nya ris can/ /phul ba de bzhin bdag 'bul gyi/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la/ / zhes sogs sngags dang bcas pas khrus gsol/ gos rgyan ni/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos/ / zhes sogs dang*/ rab byung gi cha byad can la/ dri med mtshan la sgrib bsal mi mnga' yang*/ /dad pas ngur smig rgyal mtshan phul ba yi/ /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /sangs rgyas brtul shugs mchog la spyod par shog /oṃ badzra wa sta ye āḥhūṃ swā hā/ zhes na bza' dang*/ rgyal ba mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin zhes sogs sngags dang bcas pas rgyan dbul/ rgyal ba zag med 'byor la mnga' sgyur yang*/ /'gro ba'i don du 'dod yon sna lnga yis/ /mchod pas mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi/ /bsod nams mi zad gter la spyod par shog /oṃ badzra sa manta bha tra pū dza me gha āḥhūṃ swā hā/ zhes 'dod yon sna lnga dang*/ mi dbang rin chen sna bdun 'di dag ni/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa ma lus pa/ /bshams shing yid kyi sprul te phul ba yis/ /'gro ba mi zad gter la spyod par shog /oṃ ma hā sabha ratna pū dza me gha āḥhūṃ swā hā/ rgyas par na/ 'dzam bu chu bo'i zhes sogs sngags dang bcas pas 'bul/ rgyal ba mgon po dpal gyi lha ma mer bzhugs/ /bsod nams ye shes sku mnga' brnyes pa la/

/lnga phrag lnga ldan snying bo dam pa 'bul/ /'gro bas bde gshegs snying bo mchog thob shog /oṃ pañtsa pañtsa thim la pū dza me gha āḥhūṃ/ zhes bcud nyer lnga 'bul/ gdugs sogs 'bul ba ni/ brtse ba'i khor yug snyan pa'i ba dan dang*/ /ting nge 'dzin bla re spobs pa'i 'od gsal ba/ /mchog rkyen 'os pa'i nyer mkho 'di dag 'bul/ /skye bos rnam dag ye shes thob par shog /oṃ ma hā pū dza me gha āḥhūṃ swāhā/ zhes gdugs sogs dang*/ bde gshegs rnams la 'bru phul bas/ /bdag dang 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /zas kyi 'byor ba ldan pa dang*/ /bde ba'i lo thog rgyas gyur cig / zhes 'bru sna tshogs dang*/ rin chen sna bdun phul ba yis/ /bdag dang 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /dbul ba'i sdug bsngal zhi ba dang*/ /longs spyod phun sum tshogs gyur cig / zhes rin chen sna bdun dang*/ bde gshegs rnams la sman phul bas/ /nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong gi /nad kyi sdug bsngal byang gyur nas/ /thugs rje'i sman gyis 'dul gyur cig / zhes sman sna tshogs 'bul lo/ /de nas bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig gi bkra shis kyi mnga' dbul bya'o/ /spyi'i mnga' dbul ni de tsam gyis kyang rung la/ bye brag gi mnga' dbul byed na/ spu gri 'dreg spyad so mang dang*/ /shangs dbye tshems shing snyan shal dbye/ /zhes pa ltar gsum las dang po sku gzugs la/ ji ltar rab byung mchod rten du/ /rgyal bas khyim pa'i rtags spangs ltar/ /'gro ba sems can don gyi phyir/ /khyim pa'i rtags rnams spang bar bya/ /rgyal ba'i dbu skra mthon mthing skyon bral yang*/ /gzhan don sgrub phyir khyim pa'i rtags spang phyir/ /dad pas gser gyi 'dreg spyad phul ba yis/ /'gro kun sdug bsngal kun las grol bar shog /oṃ badzra ka tsa mu la āḥhūṃ swā hā/ zhes dbu skra dang zhal spu 'breg ba'i tshul bya/

de bzhin gshegs pa'i dpe byad la/ /skyon gyis dri mas ma gos kyang*/ 'jig rten bsam pa'i rjes 'jug phyir/ /bdag gis 'dreg spyad dbul bar bya/ /zangs mdog ltar mdzes yid 'ong skyon bral yang*/ /bdag cag dang bas phyag dang zhabs rnams kyi/ /sen mo'i 'dreg spyad phul bas 'gro kun gyis/ /sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang bo thob par shog /oṃ badzra na ga tshe da dza na āḥhūṃ swāhā/ / zhes sen mo 'phreng ba'i tshul bya/ /longs sku'i cha byad can la/ rgyal ba'i dbu skra lcang lo la/ /dug gsum dri mas ma gos te/ /bkur sti dung gi so mangs kyis/ /rgyal ba'i dbu skra bshad par bya/ /dbu skra rin chen lcang lo ma 'khrugs shing*/ /mdzes shing lta bas mi ngoms skyon bral yang*/ /bdag blo sbyang phyir rkyen dang 'tsham pa 'di/ /phul bas 'gro kun dug gsum bral bar shog /oṃ badzra pā ya sho dha ya āḥhūṃ swā hā/ zhes dbu skra bshad pa'i tshul bya/ zag bcas phung bo'i dri spangs pa/ /'gro ba sems can don gyi phyir/ /rnam par dag pa'i dri skyed ltar/ /rgyal ba'i shangs ni dbye bar bya/ /dri 'dzin rnam dag tshul khrims las 'khrungs pa/ /dge ba bsgrub phyir skyon las nges grol yang*/ /mos pas 'dzin spyad dam pa phul ba las/ /'gro bas ye shes bla med thob par shog /oṃ badzra ro ma dha ra āḥhūṃ swāhā/ zhes shangs dbye ba'i tshul dang*/ rgyal ba'i tshems dkar bzhi bcu la/ /mi gtsang rdul gyis ma gos te/ /bkur sti rin chen ljon shing gis/ /rgyal ba'i tshems ni dbyi bar bya/ /dkar la thags bzang bzhi bcu tshang ba'i tshems/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos la mnga' sgyur yang*/ /bdag cag dad pas tshems shing dbul bar bgyi/ /'gro bas sangs rgyas gsung dbyangs thob par shog /oṃ badzra da na ha shodha ya āḥhūṃ swā hā/ zhes cha ེ mas dbyi pa'i tshul bya/ 'gro ba chos kyi phongs pa la/ /rgyal bas chos kyi dung bus ltar/

/de bzhin sems can don gyi phyir/ /rgyal ba'i snyan ni dbye bar bya/ /snyan sring mi mnga' kun du gsal bar ldan/ /thub pa'i sgra 'dzin ngo bos dag na yang*/ /dag byed 'di ni bdag gis 'bul lags kyi/ /skye bos rtag tu dam chos thob pa shog /oṃ badzra karṇa sho dha ya āḥhūṃ swāhā/ zhes snyan dbye ba'i tshul bya/ chos kyi ro yi dga' ba yis/ /'gro ba thams cad tshim mdzad pa/ /ro mchog brgya ldan zhal zas rnams/ /dbul phyir rgyal ba'i zhal dbye'o/ /'od stong zer gyis phye ba'i padma dang*/ /bim pa ltar dmar yid 'ong zhal gyi sgros/ /legs par phye bas mkha' mnyam sems can gyis/ /thar ba'i grong khyer sgo mchog phyed par shog /oṃ badzrod gha ṭa sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūṃ/ zhes zhal dbye ba'i tshul bya/ gnyis pa gsung rab kyi mnga' dbul la/ /khri gos glegs shing glegs thag go /zhes pa ltar/ rin chen du mas las grub seng ge'i khri/ /yid 'phrog sna tshogs gos kyis bkang ba 'di/ /rin chen gsung rab mchog la phul ba yis/ /'gro rnams rdo rje gdan la 'dug gyur cig /oṃ badzra a sa na āḥhūṃ swāhā/ zhes khri dang*/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing*/ / zhes sogs kyis na bza' dang*/ zung 'jug dam chos 'dzin pa kun bral yang*/ /thabs dang shes rab rjes su 'brel gyur pa'i/ /nyi zla lta bur rten 'brel bgab bya ba/ phul bas skye bos zung 'jug thob par shog /oṃ badzra pradzñā u pa ya a dhwa ya āḥhūṃ swāhā/ zhes glegs shing dang*/ spros pa du mar rab tu rgyas gyur kyang*/ /ye shes chen por ro gcig gyur pa ltar/ /glegs bam gcig gyur yo byad mchog phul bas/ /'gro bas ye shes chen po rtogs par shog /oṃ badzra pu sta ka bhandha āḥhūṃ swā hā/ zhes glegs baṃ rnams 'bul lo/ /gsum pa mchod rten gyi mnga' dbul ni/ /srog cig 'khor lo cod pan 'phan/ /rgyal mtshan gdugs dang phreng pa gdan/

zhes pa ltar/ sems can shes bcu ldan gyur cig /bstan pa yun ring gnas par shog /sems can lhag bsam dag pa yis/ /kun bzang smon lam 'jug par shog /oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ zhes srog shing dang*/ khams gsum sems can ma lus pa/ /stobs dang ma 'dres chos dang ni/ /dran pa nyer bzhag rnam thar brgyad/ /ye shes lnga sogs ldan par shog /oṃ pra marda na ya swā hā/ zhes 'khor lo dang*/ sems can rnams ni ma lus pa/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gzugs la/ /dar gyi lhab lhub la sogs pas/ /byang chub bar du mchod par shog /oṃ pa ṭaṃ ka laṃ ba ya swāhā/ cod pan dang*/ sems can rnams ni ma lus pa/ /phyogs bcur snyan pa'i ba dan gyis/ /'tshe ba med cing chos ldan pa'i/ /grags pas rgyas par 'grengs par shog /oṃ pa taṃ ke swā hā/ 'phan dang*/ 'khor ba ma stong bar du ni/ /bdud bzhi dag las rab rgyal nas/ /ston pa'i bstan pa zab mo dag /mi nub rgyal mtshan 'jig par shog /oṃ kumbhi ra dhwa tstsha ya swā hā/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ khams gsum sems can ma lus pa/ nyon mongs tshad pas gdungs pa la/ /thugs rje'i byang chub sems kyi gdugs/ /phul bas bde bas tshim par zhog /oṃ pra hma ṇa yi swā hā/ gtugs dang*/ 'khor ba'i sems can ma lus kun/ /mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs thob nas/ /lta bas mi ngoms gzugs kyis ni/ /sems can don rnams rdzogs byed shog /oṃ ratna ma le traṃ swā hā/ me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ sems can ma lus sangs rgyas te/ /stobs bcu ldan pa glang bo'i gdan/ /mi 'jigs seng ge'i gdan dang ldan/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang ba rta yi gdan/ /dbang bcu thob pa rma bya'i gdan/ /thogs med shugs ldan mkha' lding gdan/ /'dod dgu 'byung ba rin chen gdan/ /skyon gyis ma gos padma'i gdan/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal nyi zla'i gdan/ /gdan rnams myur du thob par shog /oṃ bu ṇya dha ri dza ya swā hā/ zhes gdan dbul de dag ni mnga' dbul te/

rten ji ltar yin pa skabs dang sbyor/ gnyis pa mjug tu shis pa brjod cing brtan bzhugs bya ba sogs la/ shis brjod bstan bzhugs bstod dang sbyar/ bzod gsol chos skyongs yon bdag bsgo/ /yon dbul zhes pa ltar/ shis brjod ni/ ye dharmā brjod cing me tog lag tu thogs nas rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas/ 'chi med lam kun ma 'am/ che ba'i ches mchog sogs sam/ yon tan rab rdzogs gangs kyi ri bo 'dra/ zhes sogs kyi shis pa brjod cing me tog 'thor ro/ /de nas brtan bzhugs ni/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā/ zhes brjod la me tog gtor/ de nas thal mo sbyar la/ ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /dga' ldan du ni gnas pa las/ lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums zhugs ltar/ /de bzhin gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'di ru mgon po rtag bzhugs nas/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa dang*/ /yon gyi bdag po'i don slad du/ /bdag gi 'byor ba nyid kyi ni/ /ci 'byor ba yi mchod pa dang*/ /me tog la sogs 'di bzhes shig /bdag dang slob mar bcas rnams la/ /rjes su brtse bar nyer dgongs nas/ /kun gyi 'di la byin rlob cing*/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs par rigs/ /

zhes dang*/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can gyi khams rnams mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag g-i bar du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /bye brag tu'ang sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di la sa dang chu dang me dang rlung gi gnod pas ma zhig gi bar de srid du sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa mdzad cing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ / lan gsum/ bde gshegs kun bzang mthong bas bkra shis ltar/ /rgyal ba sras bcas deng 'dir bde legs shog /ngan sdig log pa'i tshogs rnams bcom gyur nas/ /rgyal sras rig 'dzin tshogs rnams 'phel dar zhing*/ /zhal mthong tsam gyis bde ba'i mchog brnyes nas/ /nyi ltar zhal gro zla ltar 'od gsal zhing*/ /bdag dang 'gro la zhal gro byin che nas/ /bskal ba'i mthar thug bar du bzhugs su gsol/ /ji srid me dang chu dang ni/ /rlung gis bskal ba 'jig bar du/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bcom ldan khyod ni bzhugs par mdzod/ / ces lan gsum/ de nas yig brgya lan bdun/ mgon po bskal ba ji bzhin du/ /sna tshogs gzugs ni bzung nas kyang*/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad du/ /des ni 'gro ba'i don kun mdzod/ / ces gsol ba gdab/ de nas/ gnyis med thun mong ma yin khyab pa'i sku/ / zhes sogs ci rigs kyis bstod/ de nas yig brgya brjod/ / gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ /zhes sogs dang*/ ma rnyed yongs su zhes sogs kyi bzod pa gsol/ /de nas chos skyong bsgo ba ni bskangs gso bya ba yin na gtor ma phul te 'phrin las bcol la/ de min logs su spyan drangs te gtor 'bul byas nas 'phrin las bcol bar bya'o/ /de nas yon bdag bsgo ba ni/ /de'i mdun mchod pa tshar gcig bshams la/ khyed kyi nged la gang gsol ba'i/

/gzugs sku dag ni khyad par du/ /ji ltar gsungs pa rab gnas pa/ /de dag don ni ngas byas pas/ /de rnams don ni grub zin gyi/ /ci bde bar ni mchod par byos/ khyod kyis gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ /rab tu gnas pa byas zin gyis/ /mchod pa rgyun mi 'chad pa dang*/ /zhag bdun bar du mchod par byos/ / ces brjod la don bshad/ de nas mchod pa de nyid byin gyis brlabs te rgyas bsdus gang rung gis 'bul du gzhug/de nas bkra shis kyi rdzas rnams bsangs sbyangs te/ rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa las byung ba'i bkra shis kyi rdzas su gyur/ /sngon bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la gzugs kyi lha mo 'od 'chang mas me long phyag tu phul te bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis rlabs pa de bzhin du deng 'dir yang sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi me long gi rdzas la bstan nas bkra shis par gyur cig me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po yis/ /ye shes rgya mtsho mchog tu dag gyur te/ /rnam dag chos la thogs med longs spyod pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang sgrib pa dag gyur cig / de bzhin du sbyar nas/ glang bo cha nor skyong gis ghi hang phyag tu phul te/ ghi hang dug gsum 'joms pa nad kyi sman/ /sman mchog chos nyid rab tu rtogs gyur nas/ /nyon mongs zug rngu med par gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang sdug bsngal dag gyur cig /zhing ba'i bu mo legs skyes mas zho phyag tu phul te/ zho ni kun gyi snying bor gyur pa ste/ /snying bo rnam dag ye shes mchog rtogs nas/ /yon tan kun gyi dbyings su gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang dug gsum zhi gyur cig /rtswa tshong gi khye'u bkra shis kyis rtsa dur ba phyag tu phul te/ dung bas tshe ni 'phel bar byed pa ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni rab sgrubs nas/ /nyon mongs skye shi rgyun chad gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des ni tshe yang 'phel gyur cig

/lha tshangs pas shing tog bil ba phyag tu phul te/ bil ba rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun/ /byang chub snying bo mchog tu dag gyur pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang don kun 'grub par shog /lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dung g.yas su 'khyil ba phyag tu phul te/ dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgrogs pa'i tshul/ /ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du dag gyur te/ /chos rnams ma nor yongs su ston pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshig la dbang thob shog /bram ze dkar rgyal gyis li khri phyag phul te/ li khri dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin te/ /chos rnams ma nor dbang du bsdus nas kyang*/ /chos kyi rgyal srid rtag tu brtan gyur pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang khyod srid brtan gyur cig /gsang sngags dang rigs kyi bdag po dpal phyag na rdo rjes grub pa'i rdzas yungs kar phyag tu phul te/ yungs kar rdo rje'i rigs te thams cad du/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms par byed pa yi/ /mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs gyur pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang bgegs rnams zhi bar shog / ces brjod cing*/ bkra shis kyi rdzas rnams rab gnas byas pa'i rten rnams la 'bul ba'i tshul bya zhing*/ der yon bdag gral na gnas pa rnams kyis kyang*/ de dag la reg pas bkra shis kyi rdzas de dag gis shin tu bkra shis par 'gyur ro// //ces pa 'di ni shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis re gnyis la phan ched/ rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i rab gnas bkra shis snye ma'i dpe gzhir bzhag nas/ rang dgon gyi 'don cha dang mthun par 'jug pa bde ched du 'khrugs bsdebs phran bu dang*/ kha skong yang cung zad re byas nas bris pa'o/ /dge legs 'phel/ bkra shis/ / oṃ ye dha rmā he tu prabha wā he tunte ṣānta thā ga to hya ba da ha/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e baṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥswā hā/

/oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ sarba maṅga laṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/rab gnas bkra shis snye ma'i dgongs rgyan don gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 240-- PAGE 239-- PAGE 238-
